finding.claim: OS command injection: the unauthenticated /ping endpoint concatenates the user-supplied `host` query parameter into a shell command string passed to exec(), allowing arbitrary command execution.
finding.sink: child_process.exec("ping -c 1 " + req.query.host) at tools.js:7, which runs through a shell

trace.note: Route handler for GET /ping with no auth middleware
req.query.host concatenated unsanitized into the shell command and passed to exec()
Command stdout is returned in the response, so the output is exfiltrated (non-blind injection)

finding.guards_checked: No input validation, allowlist, or escaping on host. No authentication or authorization middleware (app has none). exec() uses a shell, so metacharacters like ;, &&, $() and backticks are interpreted. Not mitigated by execFile or an argument array. Also, host may be an array or object via qs parsing, but string concatenation still coerces it. Server listens on all interfaces at :3001 (no bind restriction).

verdict.reason: tools.js:7 passes "ping -c 1 " + req.query.host to shell-based exec() with no auth, validation or escaping (tools.js:6-13), and tools.js:11 returns stdout, so an anonymous caller gets arbitrary command execution with the output.
